t: 君士坦丁八世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一皇帝,在被加冕为同帝后63年.
te: Constantine VIII becomes sole emperor of the Byzantine Empire, 63 years after being crowned co-emperor.
dz: 君士坦丁八世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一皇帝,在被加冕为同帝后63年.
de: Constantine VIII becomes sole emperor of the Byzantine Empire, 63 years after being crowned co-emperor.

t: 将米斯兹科二世·兰伯特加冕为波兰国王.
te: Coronation of Mieszko II Lambert as king of Poland.
dz: 将米斯兹科二世·兰伯特加冕为波兰国王.
de: Coronation of Mieszko II Lambert as king of Poland.
